But what does that mean for the cryptography that protects everything from private messages to healthcare to banking and crypto wallets? Stanford cryptographer Dan Boneh, with @eddylazzarin, @SuccinctJT, @liz_harkavy, and @smc90, makes sense of the warnings sounded recently. name: Jon Durbin
title: https://github.com/chutesai/epigenesis Still experimenting, but seems to check out. Smaller, faster, better? Models that grow with you (or your repo, or proprietary company docs, etc.) Short term exact recall is the context window. Context window feeds training continuously, binary optimizer. This becomes stored knowledge and higher order perceptual understanding over time, not just RAG. Sparse MSA global attention already selects most important tokens to attend to in longer context, so you can reinforce those parts more.
